excluded.name: Katahdin Woods & Waters National Monument Camping
excluded.why: the only drive-to sites for vehicles bigger than a car are Sandbank Stream's three, whose permitted equipment is caravan/camper van, pickup camper and pop-up only (no RV or trailer), and NPS says it accommodates 'small RVs'; the rest of the facility is hike-to, walk-to and boat-in sites, lean-tos and huts, over unpaved logging roads open late May to mid-November
